snippet.title: Era Echo Gameplay FIRST LOOK
snippet.description:
🎉 Era Echo Steam page is live!

This is Jason here. I am the solo dev behind Era Echo. From filmmaking to immersive experience and now to game, seems like I’ve been changing careers all around. But one thing in common I found is my passion to create unique experiences, no matter what the form is. For the past year, I have been developing this game on my own (with my AI interns). Yes, this is my very first game developed and I am very proud to officially present it to you all.

Short desc of the game: Build your hero across 9 eras, save them as Echoes, and fight hidden-info auto battles in a cosmic tournament.

As a newbie here in the gaming world, I decided to make a game that I would play on a daily routine. From Hearthstone to Slay The Spire to The Bazar, I have spent hundreds of hours planning, strategizing. Even now I have a habit of watching streamer’s STP video before I go to sleep. (Best Melatonin ever)

If you wanna support me, search Era Echo on Steam and add to your wishlist! If you are also into card games, please feel free to lemme know and join the playtest.

Steam link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5090230/_/
